_doc: Generated per client during brief ingestion. Each entry: { id, status, builders, nota, source, acceptance }. This is the light lane of spec-driven design (SDD) — see AGENTS.md § Spec-first and specs/README.md.
_status: pending | in_progress | done — only ONE feature may be in_progress at a time. A feature cannot move to in_progress without both source and acceptance filled in.
_builders: subset of [front-end-astro, seo-guide-lines]. Sections -> front-end-astro; close each page with seo-guide-lines.
_source: REQUIRED. The brief section (or other approved document) this feature's content comes from, e.g. "arquitectura-informacion.md §2.1". No document → this isn't light-lane work, write a full spec with /spec instead.
_acceptance: REQUIRED. Boolean checklist derived from _source plus any CHECKPOINTS.md items that apply, e.g. ["h1 matches the copy in §2.1", "CTA links to /contacto"]. Verified for real by spec-verifier, same as a spec's Acceptance criteria.
